name: linear-modal
blurb: Modal that expands from a card with spring animation and layout morphing.
description: A Dialog using Framer Motion with layoutId; expands from trigger card to full-screen modal with spring animation; includes image, title, description.
use_when: Creating card-to-modal experiences with smooth layout transitions and spring animations.
avoid_when: For simple modals without animation or layout morphing — use shadcn Dialog instead.
a11y: Escape key closes modal; Tab cycles through focusables; first focusable auto-focused on open; body overflow locked.
